findings.description: [demoted to minor: no concrete failure scenario, so it cannot gate; reported as blocking by the reviewer] Design specifies CorrectionManager as the orchestration hub that drives engines, sets the armed flag, opens correction transactions, and publishes feedback events. Component is referenced in design-analysis.md as essential for Option B flow but no implementation exists in the codebase.
findings.title: CorrectionManager implementation not found

findings.description: [demoted to minor: no concrete failure scenario, so it cannot gate; reported as blocking by the reviewer] Design requires TranscriptEngine to maintain the rolling journal of typing state, including the VerdictReady state and armed flag required for Option B committing-key handling. Without it, the pre-decision mechanism cannot function. No implementation found.
findings.title: TranscriptEngine implementation not found

findings.description: [demoted to minor: no concrete failure scenario, so it cannot gate; reported as blocking by the reviewer] The keystroke accessor is the low-level keyboard hook (WH_KEYBOARD_LL) required to capture input and implement the Option B armed-flag suppression mechanism. Design requires this to read the armed flag atomically and suppress/re-inject committing keys. No implementation found.
findings.title: KeystrokeAccessor and low-level hook not implemented

findings.description: [demoted to minor: no concrete failure scenario, so it cannot gate; reported as blocking by the reviewer] Design requires InputInjectionAccessor to apply corrections via simulated input (backspaces and replacement text) and to re-inject suppressed committing keys. This is essential for executing the correction transaction. No implementation found.
findings.title: InputInjectionAccessor not implemented

findings.description: [demoted to minor: no concrete failure scenario, so it cannot gate; reported as blocking by the reviewer] Design specifies LayoutAccessor to read and switch the active keyboard layout as part of the correction flow. FR-002 requires the tool to switch layouts after correction. No implementation found.
findings.title: LayoutAccessor not implemented

findings.description: [demoted to minor: no concrete failure scenario, so it cannot gate; reported as blocking by the reviewer] Design requires FocusAccessor for foreground and control changes, password-field detection (required by FR-003, User Story 5 acceptance criteria), and caret coordinates. Critical for privacy and correctness. No implementation found.
findings.title: FocusAccessor not implemented

findings.description: [demoted to minor: no concrete failure scenario, so it cannot gate; reported as major by the reviewer] Design specifies AudioAccessor to play tiered feedback sounds (FR-023: distinct sounds for dictionary versus AI corrections). Required to provide the feedback loop promised in User Story 1. No implementation found.
findings.title: AudioAccessor not implemented

findings.description: [demoted to minor: no concrete failure scenario, so it cannot gate; reported as blocking by the reviewer] Design requires TrayClient to provide the tray icon, enable/disable controls, status display, and settings window. Required to satisfy User Story 3 (user control over pause, mode selection, per-app exclusion). No UI code found beyond MainWindow.xaml.
findings.title: TrayClient UI component not implemented

findings.description: [demoted to minor: no concrete failure scenario, so it cannot gate; reported as blocking by the reviewer] Design requires OverlayClient for the floating correction bubble near the caret showing what changed and the new layout. This is a primary feedback mechanism promised in User Story 1. No implementation found.
findings.title: OverlayClient bubble UI not implemented

findings.description: [demoted to minor: no concrete failure scenario, so it cannot gate; reported as major by the reviewer] Design requires SettingsManager to handle user configuration (language pairs, caution level, exclusions, credentials). Required for User Story 3 settings functionality and to notify CorrectionManager of changes. No implementation found.
findings.title: SettingsManager not implemented

findings.description: [demoted to minor: no concrete failure scenario, so it cannot gate; reported as blocking by the reviewer] Only platform storage layer exists (DictionaryAccessor.cs in Platform project). Design requires full accessor to load and query key maps and dictionaries, plus persist learned words (FR-009). No complete implementation with contract interface found.
findings.title: DictionaryAccessor incomplete

findings.description: [demoted to minor: no concrete failure scenario, so it cannot gate; reported as blocking by the reviewer] The three implemented engines (WordAssembly, Detection, Mapping) are not connected to any orchestration logic. No code path exists that chains keystroke capture → word assembly → mapping → detection → verdict application. The flow specified in design-analysis.md:338-361 is not implemented.
findings.title: No end-to-end integration or orchestration

findings.description: [demoted to minor: no concrete failure scenario, so it cannot gate; reported as major by the reviewer] ServiceRegistration.cs exists but likely does not wire up the full component graph required by the design. The design shows a complex dependency network (managers calling engines, accessors calling nothing) that must be configured. Without seeing full implementation, cannot verify DI configuration matches architecture.
findings.title: ServiceRegistration appears minimal

findings.description: [demoted to minor: no concrete failure scenario, so it cannot gate; reported as blocking by the reviewer] Core design decision was Option B: speculative pre-decision with armed flag, O(1) hook callback, and compensating re-injection. This requires: (1) VerdictReady state in TranscriptEngine, (2) armed flag written by CorrectionManager, (3) O(1) flag read in KeystrokeAccessor, (4) re-injection ordering. None of these are present. The design cannot be verified as implemented.
findings.title: Option B committing-key suppression mechanism not implemented

summary: Implementation skeleton present with correct core engines but critical orchestration components missing. The design specified 13 major components; only 3 engines and models are implemented. All manager, accessor, and UI components required by Option B architecture are absent. Verification evidence shows only mechanical checks passed, not completeness validation.
